intro.narration: Dawn at the market. The smell of fish and coffee. A table blocks the gap between two stalls.

intro.speaker: aling_tessie
intro.text: TESSIE FISH! Fresh! ...uy you, kid, still haggling, or ready to lose?

intro.speaker: ate_marites
intro.text: Uy Tessie. This kid is on my team. You're up against the two of us today.

intro.speaker: aling_tessie
intro.text: You?! The one who bought bangus on credit and then gossiped about my prices?!

intro.speaker: ate_marites
intro.text: Ha?! That was one time! ...and honestly, that bangus was a little spoiled, sorry.

intro.speaker: aling_tessie
intro.text: Hoy! Nothing is spoiled at Tessie Fish! Fixed price, no discounts!

intro.speaker: ate_marites
intro.text: Kid, I've got your back. Let's ipit her like one of her rigged scales.

intro.speaker: aling_tessie
intro.text: RIGGED?! My scale is accurate! ...it only gives extra, and only for you!

intro.narration: Aling Tessie slapped the table with a wet hand. The air smelled like tilapia.

intro.speaker: aling_tessie
intro.text: Go on, put down that three. But remember, at the market, I set the price.

win.speaker: aling_tessie
win.text: You're out of cards?! You got there first. Two against one, that's not fair!

win.speaker: ate_marites
win.text: Just good teamwork, Tessie! I told you, my suki here is good.

win.narration: Marites cackled. Tessie flung her towel on the table, then, quietly, she smiled.

win.speaker: aling_tessie
win.text: Hmp. Fine. Come back, there's a fresh delivery tomorrow. Still open to a little haggling, ha.

lose.speaker: aling_tessie
lose.text: HA! Even two of you, still not enough! Queen of the market, nobody beats me!

lose.speaker: ate_marites
lose.text: Come on, Tessie! That's my teammate!

lose.speaker: aling_tessie
lose.text: Alright, next time. Buy some fish first, suki discount, just a little one.

lines.speaker: aling_tessie
lines.text: Only four cards left? Haggle it down, lower that bet, kid!

lines.speaker: ate_marites
lines.text: Tessie's getting close! Ipit her now, like the last bangus at noon!
